explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `etvDist_triangle` and other `etvDist` lemmas. The only other triangle inequality is `VectorMeasure.etvDist_triangle`, in `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/VectorMeasure/TotalVariation.lean`. It is about `VectorMeasure`, not `Measure`. The Measure-level `etvDist` is defined as `∞` unless both measures are finite, and otherwise equals the vector-measure version applied to `toSignedMeasure`. The target proof uses the vector-measure lemma, but it also needs a case split on finiteness and the `∞` cases. That is more than a one- or two-line derivation, so it is not a special case. I found no other declaration that states the Measure-level triangle inequality.
